mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, we are looking at 60 degree temperatures with overcast skies at Harriet Park under a Waning Gibbous moon.

The City of Verona has provided regular engineering reports to the City Council, and the Wisconsin Department of Transportation is hosting public meetings on November 18 and 19 for the US 18/151 Corridor Study to gather community feedback on design concepts.

We have a busy schedule including Yoga at Insight Wellness, ART House 360, and Hop Haus Trivia today. Tomorrow brings the Main Street Trick-or-Treat and live music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company.
On October 25, officers arrested a 40-year-old man for an O W I after finding him asleep behind the wheel at the intersection of Plympton Street and Rita Avenue.
Today is a great day to visit because the flavor of the day is OREO REESE'S Cheesecake, and the store opens today at 10:00 AM.
